meta.name: add-rtk
meta.description: Install rtk token-compression proxy into agent containers. Routes Bash tool calls through rtk for 60–90% token savings on dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, docker, kubectl, etc.).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在容器中安装 rtk 代理以压缩令牌，节省开发命令的令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 AI 辅助开发且想减少令牌消耗
copy.tagline_en: Install rtk proxy in containers to compress tokens and save on dev commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use AI-assisted development and want to reduce token usage

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 执行 Bash 命令时会被 rtk 代理自动过滤,对 git、cargo、pytest 等开发命令压缩 token,可节省 60–90% 的 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当 Claude 调用 Bash 工具时触发(由 PreToolUse 钩子匹配 Bash),所有 Bash 调用都会被 rtk 代理过滤。

say.text: 帮我在这个 agent 组里安装 rtk 并配置好钩子
say.note: Claude 会执行安装、挂载和设置钩子步骤

say.text: 给群组 ag-1776342942165-ptgddd 挂载 rtk 代理
say.note: Claude 会添加只读挂载并重启容器

say.text: 检查 rtk 是否已装好,并查看 token 节省量

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude's Bash tool calls are automatically filtered through the rtk proxy, compressing tokens for common dev commands (git, cargo, pytest, etc.) and saving 60–90% of tokens.
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever Claude invokes the Bash tool; the PreToolUse hook matches Bash calls and routes them through rtk.

say_en.text: Install rtk in this agent group and configure the hook.
say_en.note: Claude will run setup, mount, and hook steps.

say_en.text: Mount the rtk proxy for group ag-1776342942165-ptgddd.
say_en.note: Claude adds the read-only mount and restarts the container.

say_en.text: Check if rtk is installed and show token savings.
say_en.note: Claude runs rtk --version and rtk gain.
